title: Update Zoho CRM Deals Instantly with Claude MCP #Shorts
description:
Stop wasting hours logging CRM call notes manually. Connect Claude to Zoho CRM using a custom local MCP bridge and Zoho API Console credentials to automatically update deal stages and schedule follow-up tasks directly from raw call transcripts.

1. Connect your Claude client to the Zoho MCP server
2. Paste your rough meeting notes or transcript directly into the chat
3. Ask Claude to update the specific CRM deal stage and schedule the next task

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM MCP Server
- endpoint: MCP Server: Zoho CRM Data Operations (Deals & Tasks)
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.deals.UPDATE, ZohoCRM.modules.tasks.CREATE
- docs: Zoho API Console › Self-Client Setup

Code (json) - Claude Desktop configuration file (claude_desktop_config.json):
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "zoho-crm": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/path/to/custom-zoho-mcp-bridge/index.js"],
      "env": {
        "ZOHO_CLIENT_ID": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID",
        "ZOHO_CLIENT_SECRET": "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET",
        "ZOHO_REFRESH_TOKEN": "YOUR_REFRESH_TOKEN",
        "ZOHO_CRM_DOMAIN": "https://www.zohoapis.com"
      }
    }
  }
}

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
